regions.finding: The original page shows one current-paper experiment: oxidative N-debenzylation of 3b (325.5 mg, 1.03 mmol) with t-BuOK (1124.6 mg, 10 mmol) in THF/DMSO (12.5 mL each) under an O2 balloon at room temperature for 26 h. The detailed workup and pre-eluted silica-gel chromatography afford clausine V 5b (193.6 mg, 83%). This evidence enriches the existing section-12 record rather than creating a duplicate.

Melting point, 1H/13C NMR, IR, and EI-MS data characterize clausine V 5b. They support the existing product identity but do not constitute a second preparation, reaction condition, or independent yield.
